title: Implement 12 vCPU 70% Cap Set-VMProcessor Command Builder
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Satisfy SRS-412-02-FR-002: The VM hypervisor configuration shall allocate 12 virtual CPUs with a hard 70% CPU resource allocation cap. Build Set-VMProcessor -VMName <name> -Count 12 -Maximum 70 -RelativeWeight 100 as an argv list; 70 is Hyper-V's percentage Maximum (hard cap), not Reserve. Expose VCPU_COUNT=12 and CPU_CAP_PERCENT=70 as module constants.
